text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I think something's wrong with 
me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You see, my chest feels like it's swelling 
up! It's so hot, like it's on fire!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's all simmering and jittery inside me! 
I wonder what's happened to me!?
choice_data_list:
I think that's what it means to give it 
your all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is what it means to be 
serious. I feel like I kind of understand 
now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So it's fine just like this, right? I'll 
do my best as my simmering self!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm gonna go grab 1st place, 
okay!

Haru Urara surely knows by now that this 
is going to be an exceptionally tough 
race. She knows that simply stepping up to 
run is an achievement in itself.

“Still, she will not give up. Yes, right 
from the very beginning, she never once 
gave up. That is why—”
choice_data_list: I'll be waiting for you in 1st place!
I'll be waiting for you in 1st place!

text_block_list.text:
“—The thunderous roar of the crowd draws 
closer. Perhaps among them, few truly 
believe in her victory.”

However, *I* believe. ――That Haru Urara 
will come back victorious!

However, *I* believe. ――That Haru Urara 
will come back victorious!
